rules.choose: Resume the current chat's unfinished claimed branch first. Otherwise atomically claim an eligible published task. If no published task is eligible, independently derive and publish a bounded worker-only CMS proposal from approved product goals and observed code gaps; do not ask the owner for the next FCP number.
rules.atomic_reservation: Create the exact claim_branch and suggested feature branch from that task's published proposal_base_sha. If the claim already exists, treat it as a hard lock; the owning continuation resumes it and every other AI skips it.
rules.no_worker_numbers: Worker numbers are not assignment identities. Any authorized Worker AI uses the same shared pool.
rules.one_at_a_time: Exactly one feature package per continuation chat may be actively edited. Different chats may work concurrently only with distinct exclusive claim branches, disjoint allowed paths and no unresolved shared migration, DI or template conflict. A shared GitHub login is not a global one-package lock.
rules.lease: An in-progress reservation expires seven hours after the last verified push; before the first push, it expires seven hours after claimed_on. After expiry the task becomes unclaimed and may be reclaimed with a new claim generation. Preserve its feature branch, PR, exact HEAD and CI evidence; a new owner resumes that work. A completed green Worker PR awaiting Trusted resolution remains locked and does not expire.
rules.dependencies: For Worker proposal sequencing, a dependency is satisfied by either Trusted integration in worker/main or a completed Worker PR with green CI on its exact HEAD. This only authorizes stacked untrusted proposal work; it never marks the dependency integrated and never authorizes Trusted merge or deployment.
rules.final_authority: Never merge to Trusted and never deploy.
rules.resume_before_claim: Before looking for an unclaimed task, resume any package in recovery_queue in listed order. Existing own work is never skipped merely because its claim branch exists.
rules.self_reconcile: After a Worker PR has green CI on its exact final HEAD, the owning Worker updates its own package to worker_complete_awaiting_trusted_review with PR, HEAD and CI evidence. It may then update exactly one still-unclaimed dependent package with a deterministic proposal_base_branch/proposal_base_sha and clear only dependencies proven by exact green Worker CI or Trusted integration. It must never set integrated, release/delete claims, modify another active claim, merge to Trusted or deploy.
rules.claim_lock: The current claim blocks other chats only while its seven-hour lease is valid. At expiry, the task is reclaimable; an old chat loses write authority and must re-read the live pool before any continuation. The prior branch is retained as recovery evidence, not as an active lock.
rules.continue_after_interrupt: On interruption, re-read the live pool and branch. Resume the same work only if its claim lease is still valid. If expired, do not write under the old claim; reclaim the task with a new claim generation, then continue from the exact remote HEAD without resetting or discarding work.
rules.proposal_stacking: A single completed dependency uses that dependency's exact green feature HEAD as proposal base. Multiple completed dependencies require an explicitly published Worker-only composition base with complete green CI before the next claim. Never guess or blind-merge a composition base.
rules.no_account_baselines: New work uses worker/main or an explicitly published exact green predecessor/composition HEAD. Retired numbered account baselines are not assignment sources.
rules.autonomous_continuation: After every green exact-head Worker PR, self-reconcile and continue to the next dependency-safe package. If the finite task list is exhausted or blocked, plan a new small worker-only proposal from the approved CMS scope, record scope, dependencies, base SHA, path collision checks, tests and Fortress/privacy impact in this pool, reserve an exclusive claim, then implement without another owner instruction. A proposal is never a Trusted FCP integration.
rules.connector_access: Use the connected GitHub plugin for repository writes. Missing terminal credentials or failed command-line git push is not a blocker unless a GitHub plugin write also fails for authorization.
rules.no_false_global_block: Re-evaluate all unclaimed packages and exact green predecessors after each completion. If none can start, prepare a verified composition or self-publish a new independent worker-safe proposal. A finite or blocked list alone is not a reason to stop; report only a concrete security, scope, authorization, CI or unresolvable dependency conflict.
rules.self_expand: Owner-approved standing instruction: independently decompose the secure gaming CMS goal and existing documented gaps into bounded worker-visible proposals. Assign a unique WCP identifier and atomic claim branch, use only current sanitized worker main or a verified green composition base, state exact allowed/forbidden paths, acceptance checks, real dependencies and collision proof. Never remove existing FCP dependencies, edit another chat's claim, invent private components, set integrated or merge/deploy to Trusted. Trusted maps the proposal to the canonical queue before intake.
rules.trusted_review_not_scheduler: Trusted review is the later integration gate, not a prerequisite for further Worker proposal development. A completed green Worker PR remains untrusted and claim-locked, but it does not globally block independent Worker-visible CMS work.
rules.empty_pool_behavior: Never report an empty or blocked finite pool as the end of work. Inspect the worker-visible code and approved CMS goal, publish a bounded non-conflicting WCP proposal, claim it atomically and continue implementation.
